title: Say Apay ya Anguman ed Kapalaran
intro: Nen inmunan panaon na too, say sakey a kamarerwa et mangiyoopresi na regalo ya puro so getma to. Balet, say imon so akaamot ed anino na pangawat. Amtaen so istorya na sayan too ya say inka-dios tan makapasinagem ya anggaan to et ag-onpatey ed madibinon panangiparungtal.
clues: Kaiba ak ed saray sankaunaan a kailalakan na katooan.
Angiter ak na bagat ed Katawan ko, tan inawat itan a maong.
Ag-inawat so apay nen agik, tan say imon so amabilunget ed puso to.
Inkuankod sikato, 'No iyunat moy limam ed siak pian pateyen mo ak, ag ko met iyunat so limak a pateyen ta ka; talagan tatakotan ko si Allah, say Katawan na amin a mundo.'
Siak so nagmaliw a biktima na sankaunaan a gawa na panagpatey ed dalin.
Inmakis so dalak, tan siak so sankaunaan ya martir na inka-inosente.

trial.answer: Inawat so apay to, ya sengegan na imon na agi to tan sikatoy pinatey da

outcome.answer: Say sankaunaan ya impamatey ed awaran; say agi to et nasentensiaan

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
